policy: Only CC0 recordings, each checked on its original Freesound page. Nothing is fetched from outside at runtime; every file below is served from this folder. Nothing comes from the Ballers repository.
original: Game design, rules, momentum and surges, debut XI draw and reveal (src/features/games/pitch-duel).
Pack, card back, floodlights, beams, sparks, crowd, pitch and celebration art (CSS gradients and inline SVG).
Card whooshes, flips, reveal booms, sparkles, risers, duel clashes, surge and result stings (WebAudio synthesis).
National colour bands for the walkout (plain three-band colours, not flag artwork).
